description: Frozen M1 shared special-probe manifest across Anima, MOSS-Image, and Krea 2 Raw. Contains 20 spatial relation prompts (10 rank / 10 eval, disjoint by family_id, reversed left/right and on top of/underneath pairs for E4-4 and E3-3), E3-2 PCI temporal insertion pairs, E2-2/E3-0/E3-1 counterfactual contrast pairs, and E3-4 SAP 2-stage prompt bundles.

default_negative_prompts.anima: worst quality, low quality, score_1, score_2, score_3, blurry, jpeg artifacts
default_negative_prompts.moss_image: worst quality, bad anatomy, watermark, jpeg artifact
